messages:
anya: Quick sync — spotted a couple small but important nits on the Compliance page during the console pass. Putting them here so we can triage before the next patch. Fig link: https://www.figma.com/file/xxxx/Compliance-Console maria: Thanks — can you list the ones you want dev to look at? I skimmed earlier but missed the retention control flow. anya: Sure. 1) The retention control label currently says "Data expiry". Product suggestion is "Retention period" or "Data retention (expiry)" for clarity. 2) The knob UX for "Forever" vs numeric days is confusing — when users toggle to "Forever" the input remains editable and looks like a bug. josh: For (2) we can disable the numeric input when Forever is selected. Small state change. Want me to file a PR or do you prefer a design update first? @maria maria: Design-wise prefer that the input collapses to a single pill that reads "Retention: Forever" and the numeric field is hidden. That reduces visual noise. Also add a tooltip: "Data retained until you change this setting". :information_source: anya: Good. 3) KMS label: current badge says "Customer key". Security prefers "Customer-managed key (BYOK)" for consistency with our docs and external audits. ryan: Agree on BYOK wording. Also the badge needs a "key ownership" accessible description for screen readers: e.g., "Encryption key: customer-managed (BYOK)". We need to include that in aria-labels. samuel: Accessibility nits: focus order jumps from the region dropdown to the audit log link, skipping the retention control. Keyboard users lose context. Also the KMS badge is a decorative SVG with no text fallback — add aria-hidden if purely decorative, but if it conveys state it needs text. anya: Good catches. For the region selector: request to add a small hint "Selected region affects data residency and latency" under the dropdown, and make it programmatically associated (aria-describedby). josh: I can implement aria-describedby tie-in. Quick example I can push: ``` Selected region affects data residency and latency ``` maria: Copy tweak: change audit log timestamps to include timezone short code, e.g., "2025-11-08 14:23 UTC" rather than just the offset. Users in legal teams asked for explicit UTC label. policy-bot: [policy] Reminder: audit log timestamp display must match retention policy export format for compliance exports. See internal doc: /policies/retention/export-timestamp anya: Nice — we'll standardize on "YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm UTC". Add an inline setting under Audit Logs to select display timezone (default UTC) later. ryan: One more: KMS affiliation — when an org has multiple BYOK keys, the UI needs to show which key is attached to which resource. Suggest a small inline link "Key details" that opens a drawer with key id, creation date, and rotation policy. maria: Agree. In drawer include explicit label "Key ID" and avoid colon-heavy microcopy. Also ensure the drawer heading is

for structure. samuel: For screen readers, when the drawer opens, focus should move to the drawer heading and the rest should be inert. We'll need a small focus management util. anya: OK next steps: maria to update figma with the pill + tooltip and drawer mock, samuel to write the a11y acceptance criteria, josh to file a small frontend ticket for input hiding + aria changes, ryan to draft KMS copy, and I'll coordinate QA. maria: I'll update figma by EOD and post the artboard here when done. josh: I'll make the ticket today and link it to this thread. ryan: Drafting the KMS copy now, will post in ~30m. policy-bot: [reminder] Compliance review slot booked: Thu 10:00 PT — bring the updated mocks. anya: Thanks all. Tagging acceptance: @samuel for a11y signoff, @ryan for security copy, @josh for implementation. :thumbsup:
